chk_problem.label: accurate
chk_problem.poster_evidence: Pelvic pathologies like PCOS and pelvic fracture lack public, well-annotated datasets despite clinical importance.
chk_problem.reason: The poster accurately describes the lack of public, well-annotated datasets for PCOS and pelvic fracture under the 'Problem & Gap' section.

chk_method.label: accurate
chk_method.poster_evidence: PelviNeXt is a modality-agnostic hybrid architecture applied identically to ultrasound and X-ray. It consists of: (1) Dense Feature Extractor (DFE) with 4 dense blocks (6,12,24,16 layers) inspired by DenseNet, producing multi-scale feature maps; (2) Hierarchical CBAM (H-CBAM) after each DFE block, applying channel and spatial attention at 4 scales (56×56 to 7×7); (3) Multi-Scale Fusion Module (MSFM) aligning and fusing outputs of DFE-2,3,4 to 7×7, reducing to 512 channels; (4) Talking-Heads Multi-Head Self-Attention (TH-MHSA) with head-mixing projections before/after softmax for global context
chk_method.reason: The poster details the PelviNeXt architecture, including all components (DFE, H-CBAM, MSFM, and TH-MHSA) matching the reference.

chk_data.label: accurate
chk_data.poster_evidence: Original PCOSGen (4,668 images: 1,319 Normal, 3,349 Abnormal) reduced to 225 images (63 Normal, 162 Abnormal) — a 95.2% reduction. We publicly release this deduplicated version. PXR150 (150 X-rays: 100 fracture, 50 normal) is used as-is.
chk_data.reason: The poster specifies the deduplicated PCOSGen dataset with 225 images and the PXR150 dataset with 150 radiographs.
